findings.title: Contract headers without evidence headers silently legacy
findings.problem: IngestRoute selects the legacy gate when none of EVIDENCE_HEADERS is present. The publication-contract, consent and funding headers are not in that tuple, so a request carrying only those is parsed and accepted by check_publication_contract, then stored under the legacy project gate with a 200, no echo and no consent/contract binding.
findings.impact: Violates 'legacy only when all new headers absent' and 'malformed/unsupported is non-success': a consent or contract request is ignored and stored by legacy rules instead of being rejected or held, and the client gets a success without the echo.
findings.recommendation: When a PublicationContract was parsed and no evidence/session id is present, reject with 422 (e.g. publication_contract_requires_session) before any write; add a test per ingest route.
findings.check_notes: cli_analytics_ingest_route.py:159 raises 422 publication_contract_requires_session after the rollout check; test added for all routes.

fix.change: check_publication_contract rejects a contract request without a non-blank session id with 422 publication_contract_requires_session before body/write

findings.title: Echo header may fail to encode project name
findings.problem: echo_headers puts binding.project_name into a response header. Starlette encodes header values as latin-1, so a project name with non-latin-1 or control characters raises at response build time, after the data was stored. Whether project names can contain such characters was not confirmed.
findings.impact: Client sees a 500 after a successful write and retries; reachability unconfirmed, so severity capped at major.
findings.recommendation: Emit the bound-project header only when the name is latin-1 printable (no CR/LF), else send destination only; add a test with a non-ASCII project name.
findings.check_notes: Project names are ASCII-only by ProjectService.PROJECT_NAME_PATTERN; unreachable, hardening deferred to controller note.

fix.change: no code change: project names are ASCII-only (PROJECT_NAME_PATTERN), header-safe; noted as conditional hardening in the CLI handoff
